page.layout: One page of text, single column; a heading block at the top: page number centred above a two-line title; then a three-column table (Nomen | Figura | Potestas) with rows of letter names, glyph figures and values. No margin notes.
page.notes: The title "Alphabetum Coptum, seu Ægyptiacum." is set in italic. The Coptic glyphs in the Figura column are reproduced approximately; the small lowercase forms beside the capitals are cursive Coptic letterforms and could not be read letter by letter, so they are given as near equivalents only. Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible at the right margin and is omitted.
